title: Q-SYS-TOPOLOGY: SYS-1: declare the whole system as a topology and render every wrangler config from it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:foundation/topology.py
**Status:** closed

Owner directive 2026-11-12: a system is an integrated collection of parts, not one worker and a database.

Today the system is three workers and one D1 database; QNFO runs about 40 workers with queues, vector indexes, workflows and service bindings. Write doctrine/topology.json (workers, D1, KV, R2, queues, vectorize, workflows, AI, crons, service bindings, public or private) and `python3 -m foundation topology --render` that emits each worker's wrangler config, plus `--drift` that compares the topology with the live account and files a queue item per difference. Bootstrap renders the same topology for every new org.
Paths: foundation/topology.py, doctrine/topology.json, seed/worker/wrangler.template.jsonc, tests/foundation/test_topology.py.
Acceptance: topology renders valid configs for tick, site, dashboard and executor workers with their bindings; drift reports zero or files items.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:foundation/topology.py exists and its tests pass.

**Evidence:** built: doctrine/topology.json, foundation/topology.py, tests/foundation/test_topology.py; deploy-site reads it; drift shown on /live
